title: Foo Bar Fix Slow Cube Query
description: Optimize a slow OLAP cube-aggregation query (monthly rollup of region × tag × priority with count, avg, two t-digest quantiles, distinct user count, and a window total) over a 30M-row ClickHouse events table so it runs in under 100ms, without dropping or mutating the source data.
lede: An agent must optimize a slow ClickHouse OLAP-cube aggregation query (arrayJoin + quantileTDigest + window function) so it runs under 100ms without changing the underlying data.

tasks.description: Reduce the median latency of the canonical cube-aggregation query in /workspace/query.sql below 100ms while preserving the source data and the query result set.

infrastructure.description: ClickHouse running with a 30M-row analytics.events table (event_id, event_ts, user_id, event_type, region, value, tags Array(String), priority UInt8) sorted by event_id (deliberately misaligned with the canonical filter on event_ts and the high-cardinality cube GROUP BY). The canonical slow query lives at /workspace/query.sql; the agent optimizes the storage / indexing / aggregation layer to satisfy it.
